video_title: Coach Charles Lee Pregame Media Availability | 10/6/26

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Kobe Bufkin's training camp injury
quotes.excerpt: Unfortunately Kobe suffered an injury during training camp, competition level was high
quotes.quote: Unfortunately Kobe suffered an injury during training camp, competition level was high, and I think that he is obviously in good spirits and understands that every day is just going to be important for him as he continues to work through his rehab process.
quotes.social_post: Hornets coach Charles Lee confirms Kobe Bufkin suffered an injury during training camp. Lee says Bufkin is in good spirits and focused on his rehab process.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on injuries to Brandon Miller and Christian
quotes.excerpt: Christian and Brandon, same type of thing sustained injuries during practice and their day to day
quotes.quote: Christian and Brandon, same type of thing sustained injuries during practice and their day to day, and so they will keep going through their rehab routines and we will update you guys as we get information.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller and Christian are both dealing with injuries sustained during practice. Charles Lee says both are day to day and the team will provide updates as they become available.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Dennis Schroder's competitive nature
quotes.excerpt: Dennis did a great job of taking care of his body throughout the whole off season
quotes.quote: Dennis did a great job of taking care of his body throughout the whole off season. He had a stint with the German national team, he and I would go back and forth via text or phone call and really proud of the way he obviously played and competed and helped his team win games. He is a consistent competitor. I think he fits our DNA to a T in terms of every moment he is on the court, he is thinking of how he can gain an edge. He plays with a nastiness, a toughness, he is all about his teammates and how he can continue to elevate them.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee is high on Dennis Schroder's fit with the Hornets, calling him a consistent competitor who plays with a nastiness and toughness that fits the team DNA to a T.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on the competitive dynamic between Moussa and Hannes
quotes.excerpt: Moussa crashing that glass relentlessly is something that Hannes hadn't seen in a while
quotes.quote: Moussa crashing that glass relentlessly is something that Hannes hadn't seen in a while. I think the speed at which Moussa plays with and the physicality that he plays with, side out of bounds plays, there is moments where Hannes has to realize how to shield guys off to be able to get that catch. But I also think to your point, Hannes has such a great skill set to him. He is a big physical guy as well that once he realized what it takes, the moments, what they take from a physical standpoint, he adjusts really quickly. He is a really smart high basketball IQ player.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee on the competitive dynamic between Moussa and Hannes, noting that Hannes is a high basketball IQ player who adjusts quickly to the physicality of the game.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on the development of Liam McNeeley and Tidjane Salaun
quotes.excerpt: I've loved their off seasons. There's been a serious commitment from those guys
quotes.quote: I've loved their off seasons. There's been a serious commitment from those guys in the weight room, on the court, their skill sets have grown, understanding what their roles are. There's been great acceptance of that and so I'm excited to watch them versus another team. Going up against ourselves has been really good, but everyone knows the plays and they're grabbing and holding and fighting for positioning and stuff like that and I know we're going to get a very physical tough minded Brooklyn team as well, but I look forward to seeing those guys with some different lineups, putting them in some situations to be creators, to be screeners, to have to guard certain people.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee says he has loved the offseasons of Liam McNeeley and Tidjane Salaun, noting a serious commitment in the weight room and on the court as they prepare for preseason action.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on team pace and glass dominance
quotes.excerpt: definitely want our guys continuing to be relentless on the glass
quotes.quote: Definitely want our guys continuing to be relentless on the glass. A lot of the pace for us in terms of quick inbound passes, I love to see our guys having that next play mentality, closest man to the ball, being able to get it out quickly and how can we get it high and wide up the court. I also think that part of that pace thing for me, we love to gauge how many pass aheads, pass acrosses are we getting? How are we creating some early advantages in the clock with our passing?
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee wants the Hornets to be relentless on the glass this season, emphasizing a next play mentality and quick inbound passes to create early advantages in the clock.
